findings.title: Proof validity ignores the claim's declared surface
findings.evidence: runner.check() references surface

findings.title: A claim stays PROVEN after its procedure is deleted
findings.evidence: a missing procedure now invalidates the claim

findings.title: Proof staleness binds only the procedure, not the implementation
findings.evidence: only inspect.getsource() of the decorated function is pinned

findings.title: Truncated proof ledger still yields full attestation
findings.evidence: runner.py now considers loaded.truncated

findings.title: CI claims gate accepts every nonzero result
findings.evidence: the claims gate propagates a failing exit code

findings.title: --isolated cannot start a separate-UID recorder
findings.evidence: the plist is written to $HOME/Library/LaunchAgents, which launchd runs as the logged-in user, so the recorder shares the agent's uid; the installer no longer reports tier 2 for it

findings.title: Tier 1 and the default keyfile do not separate key from agent
findings.evidence: '+isolated' requires isolation_tier >= 2, i.e. a different uid; same-uid tier 1 now reports plain 'chain-keyed'

findings.title: PostToolUse bypasses cocd and can lose records silently
findings.evidence: hook_post calls ledger.sink.record() directly, never recorder.client.append()

findings.title: Failed tool executions are not covered (PostToolUseFailure)
findings.evidence: PostToolUseFailure is a documented event and is not registered

findings.title: The recorder authenticates ordering, not event truth
findings.evidence: no peer-credential check; any local process may append arbitrary event content

findings.title: Custody schema is not enforced at the recorder boundary
findings.evidence: validate_tier_a() is only reachable via CustodyRecord.build(); sink.record() and daemon op_append() accept any dict

findings.title: doctor does not inspect the installed architecture
findings.evidence: self_check() receives only argv0, manifest, root, ledger_dir — no settings.json, pinned registration, daemon pid/uid or peer credentials, so the reported isolation tier cannot exceed 0

findings.title: Project-writable config can downgrade enforcement
findings.evidence: project .stop-guessing.json precedes profile config and can set posture=observe / protect_ledger=false with no managed-policy floor

findings.title: Rules/policies/handlers are untrusted mutable inputs
findings.evidence: policy_set_digest is recorded but never compared to a trusted expectation

findings.title: Symlink aliasing bypasses PreToolUse classification
findings.evidence: classify_path() runs on the user-supplied spelling at char 2905; canonicalisation via identify() only at 3200

findings.title: Artifact identity changes on atomic replacement
findings.evidence: artifact_id incorporates dev/inode; atomic replacement mints a new id

findings.title: Project handler executes on classified data before policy
findings.evidence: handlers.substitute() at char 4355 precedes policy evaluate() at 4850

findings.title: Signed-script execution bypassable by its paired test
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: Delegation has test/hash/execute TOCTOU races
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: bar sends full handler output to model-visible context
findings.evidence: the gate routes handler output through emit_for_model()

findings.title: Delegated execution is not sandboxed
findings.evidence: isolation is an env allowlist plus proxy variables; no OS capability boundary

findings.title: State read, decision and append are not atomic
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: Ledger integrity failure falls back to mutable cache
findings.evidence: state_for() catches Exception broadly, so wrong key / broken chain / unreadable ledger all degrade to the agent-writable cache

findings.title: Gap-recording and decision-recording failures can be silent
findings.evidence: _record_gap() uses from_env() only; against an installed keyed ledger it refuses

findings.title: Ledger replay is not equivalent to live custody state
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: The bytes read into model context are not bound
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: Only one 'worst' candidate is evaluated per call
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: Shell path and egress heuristics are bypassable
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: Session-state cache filenames can collide
findings.evidence: the cache filename is a digest of the full session id

findings.title: Sealing does not archive, rotate or freeze a segment
findings.evidence: seal() writes a MAC sidecar only — no rename/replace/move anywhere in the module, so the active ledger stays appendable after sealing

findings.title: Ledger IO mishandles partial writes and malformed middles
findings.evidence: writes are looped/length-checked

findings.title: Append and daemon design allow exhaustion and downgrade
findings.evidence: every append re-reads and re-verifies the whole ledger — O(n^2) lifetime

findings.title: CLI and hook use different default ledgers and key discovery
findings.evidence: cmd_ledger defaults to ~/.stop-guessing/ledger.jsonl while the hook writes $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/stop-guessing/ledger/custody.jsonl

findings.title: The plugin package is not self-contained
findings.evidence: 0 Python files under the plugin subtree; hooks invoke `python3 -m stop_guessing...` resolved from ambient PATH/PYTHONPATH

findings.title: Wheel/sdist packaging omits required runtime assets
findings.evidence: no package-data and no MANIFEST.in; a wheel omits VERSION, policy/, rules/

findings.title: Installer upgrades can leave stale mixed-version code
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: Installer settings/service changes are non-atomic
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: Missing vendored hook is silently skipped
findings.evidence: a missing required rule fails closed

findings.title: CLAIM-18's 'CI performs no fetch' assertion is false
findings.evidence: the CI sub-claim is withdrawn in claims.yaml and the procedure now enumerates what CI actually fetches instead of denying it

findings.title: CAIQ fill trusts editable YAML without re-deriving
findings.evidence: cmd_fill reads the editable YAML and writes it without re-deriving from the ledger

findings.title: CLAIM-21 is circular and spans two evidence epochs
findings.evidence: the carried workbook reports 20/21 against 21 claims: CLAIM-21 fills the questionnaire before its own proof record exists

findings.title: Attestation does not validate CAIQ metadata/mapping
findings.evidence: no static predicate; requires a live adversarial test

findings.title: External CAIQ verification path is machine-specific
findings.evidence: the verifier is resolved portably

findings.title: Known adequacy objections do not affect the verdict
findings.evidence: goal_met excludes the judge panel's deferred disapprovals by construction

findings.title: CLAIM-20 checks presence and permissive exit codes
findings.evidence: CLAIM-20 accepts exit code 1 as a successful surface exercise

findings.title: OpenTelemetry export is not valid OTLP JSON
findings.evidence: no resourceSpans/scopeSpans envelope; OTLP JSON requires it and encodes enums as integers

findings.title: Exports accept a truncated ledger prefix
findings.evidence: cmd_export checks truncated

findings.title: Lifecycle and batch events are not registered
findings.evidence: 2 of 31 documented events registered (PostToolUse, PreToolUse); no session boundary, prompt lineage, compaction, batch or reconciliation evidence

findings.title: Request/result reconciliation is absent at runtime
findings.evidence: ledger/reconcile.py is imported by no hook or CLI runtime path

findings.title: Record ids can collide; disable mode is unaudited
findings.evidence: the disable switch records a transition

findings.title: Mixed full/flat records make sufficiency unattainable
findings.evidence: sufficiency requires every record to populate every regime; flat events make it permanently incomplete

findings.title: Strength labels overstate isolation
findings.evidence: '+isolated' requires isolation_tier >= 2, i.e. a different uid; same-uid tier 1 now reports plain 'chain-keyed'

findings.title: Public proof counts include superseded historical refs
findings.evidence: the page renders current live evidence separately from historical runs
